svg.title: Interactive agent and skill hierarchy
svg.desc: Select an agent to highlight its skills, or select a skill to highlight every agent using it. Turn on agent dependencies to reveal arrows from using agents to used agents. Setup-time stack and domain skills are intentionally omitted because conceptual agent definitions do not link to them.
svg.text: Choose an agent or skill. Trace its relationships.
All agents and skills shown. Agent dependency arrows are visible.

g.aria-label: Select an agent or skill to view its definition
